name: British Columbia first-time home buyers' exemption
description: Qualifying first-time buyers pay no property transfer tax on the first $500,000 of value for homes up to $835,000, phasing out to zero at $860,000 (registrations from 1 April 2024).

attributes.eligibility_status: Canadian citizen or permanent resident; principal residence (program page)
